name: s3ClearBucket
description: Deletes every object in an S3 (or S3-compatible) bucket, leaving the bucket itself in place.

params.name: bucket
params.description: The name of the S3 bucket to empty.

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: Inline AWS access key id. Overrides credentials from Application.cfc and environment variables.

params.name: host
params.description: Inline endpoint URL for S3-compatible providers (e.g. Cloudflare R2, MinIO).

examples.title: Empty a bucket
examples.description: Removes all objects from the bucket.
